name: konsili-tradingview-workflow
description: Stage-gated TradingView analysis workflow contracts for Ian Copsey Fractal Forecasting reports

scripts.validate:all: bash -lc "pass=0; fail=0; failures=(); for dir in analysis_journal/*; do [ -d $dir ] || continue; if npm run validate:hew -- $dir/evidence.json; then echo PASS $dir; pass=$((pass+1)); else echo FAIL $dir; fail=$((fail+1)); failures+=($dir); fi; done; echo validate:all summary: pass=$pass fail=$fail; if [ $fail -gt 0 ]; then printf 'Failed packages:\n'; printf ' - %s\n' ${failures[@]}; fi; exit 0"
